justification: Although the case involves assembly-related Article 11 complaints, the Court disposes of them in a single cursory paragraph by reference to well-established case-law without conducting a standalone Article 11 merits analysis, and the operative provisions do not identify a specific Article 11 violation separately from the general basket of 'other complaints under well-established case-law,' failing to constitute a genuine merits adjudication with a coherent, unified Article 11 reasoning.
